tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)p[$1]+=$2;else n[$1]+=-$2} END {for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\texcess=%d\\tratio=%.3f\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k],n[k]?p[k]/n[k]:999}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)p[$1]+=$2;else n[$1]+=-$2} END {for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\texcess=%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr | head -30
jq -s '{bad:([.[]|select(.value>0)|.value]|add),good:([.[]|select(.value<0)|-.value]|add),lines:length}' samples.jsonl"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [(.value|if .>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end), .labels.source_session[0], ((.value|abs)|tostring)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$3; seen[$1 SUBSEP $2]=1} END {for(s in sum){n=0;for(k in seen){split(k,a,SUBSEP);if(a[1]==s)n++} printf "%s repeated_ops=%d sessions=%d'"\\n\",s,sum[s],n}}'
jq -r '[if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end, (.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\"), ((.value|abs)|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{tot["'$1]+=$3;if($2=="true")rep[$1]+=$3} END{for(s in tot)printf "%s repeated=%d total=%d rate=%.2f%%'"\\n\",s,rep[s],tot[s],100*rep[s]/tot[s]}'
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)p[$1]+=$2;else n[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in p)printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\texcess=%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr"
